A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { bullets: "*+-" };
  const result = convert("<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/1\">a</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">b</a></td><td><a href=\"/3\">c</a></td></tr></table>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
